topic: Islamic geometric patterns: artists made amazing stars and repeating patterns using only a compass and a straight ruler. Show a circle becoming a star, then a whole tiled wall.

episode.title: Sirf Do Auzaar Se Sitaron Bhari Deewar!

shots.narration: اتنے سارے ستارے، صرف دو اوزاروں سے کیسے بنے؟
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, warm 3D family animation. A Pakistani home with an arched window and a blue geometric tile on a low table. Nana wears a cream kurta, brown waistcoat and round glasses; Areeba wears a yellow shalwar kameez and light-pink dupatta. No writing anywhere.
shots.action: Areeba points at the star pattern on the tile.

shots.narration: اریبہ، کاریگر پرکار اور سیدھے پیمانے سے ایسے نقش بناتے تھے۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, the same cozy home and low table, with a metal compass, an unmarked straightedge and blank paper. Warm 3D family-film style, no text or ruler graduations.
shots.action: Nana places the two tools beside the patterned tile.

shots.narration: [surprised] مگر ایک دائرے سے ستارہ کیسے بنے گا؟
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, close view of Areeba at the home table, with blank paper, a compass and an unmarked straightedge in the foreground. Soft golden 3D lighting, no writing.
shots.action: Areeba tilts her head toward the tools.

shots.narration: پہلے پرکار سے ایک گول دائرہ بناتے ہیں۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, overhead close-up of Nana's ordinary elderly hand and a compass on blank cream paper at the home table. Warm 3D animation, geometric lines only, no writing.
shots.action: Nana rotates the compass to draw one circle.

shots.narration: پھر اسی پرکار سے چھ برابر فاصلے نشان لگاتے ہیں۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, educational 3D tabletop visualization of the same circle and compass, its opening fixed at the circle's radius. Only geometric marks, no hands, people, labels or writing.
shots.action: The animated compass steps around the circumference to mark six equally spaced points.

shots.narration: [excited] اب ایک نشان چھوڑ کر لکیریں ملائیں، مثلث بن گئی!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, close overhead 3D view of the circle with six equally spaced points and an unmarked straightedge. No people or writing.
shots.action: The animated straightedge traces a triangle through alternating points.

shots.narration: باقی نشان ملائیں، تو چھ کونوں والا ستارہ بن گیا!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, the same geometric construction on cream paper, with one completed triangle inside the circle. Warm 3D lighting, no labels or writing.
shots.action: The animated straightedge connects the remaining three points into a second triangle.

shots.narration: یہی ستارہ رنگوں کے ساتھ ٹائل پر بھی سج سکتا ہے۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, a single square ceramic tile bearing the same six-pointed geometric star, centered on a sandstone work surface. Stylized 3D visualization, no people or writing.
shots.action: Turquoise and deep-blue glaze fills the tile's geometric compartments.
shots.mood: Rich color, handmade beauty and warm light.

shots.narration: [excited] ایک ہی نقش دہرائیں، تو نمونہ بڑھتا جاتا ہے!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, a front-facing educational 3D arrangement of matching square star tiles against a plain sandstone wall. No people, symbols resembling writing, or captions.
shots.action: Matching tiles slide into an aligned repeating grid.

shots.narration: یوں اسلامی عمارتوں کی دیواریں خوب صورت نمونوں سے سجتی تھیں۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, a generic historic Islamic courtyard with a completed blue geometric tiled wall, sandstone arches and a quiet garden. Warm 3D family-film look, no people, inscriptions or signs.
shots.action: Sunlight slowly travels across the repeating star tiles.
shots.mood: Peaceful admiration and golden architectural beauty.

shots.narration: دیکھا اریبہ، ایک دائرے سے کتنا خوب صورت نقش بنا!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, back in the same Pakistani home. The completed paper construction rests beside the original blue star tile and the two tools. Nana and Areeba sit together, no writing anywhere.
shots.action: Areeba holds her geometric drawing beside the matching tile.
shots.mood: Warm pride, understanding and family closeness.

shots.narration: [whispers] اب بتاؤ، پرانے باغوں میں پانی کیسے پہنچتا تھا؟
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, Nana and Areeba beside the home's arched window, overlooking a small garden with a narrow water channel. Golden evening 3D lighting, no writing or additional people.
shots.action: Nana points toward the garden's water channel.
shots.mood: Quiet curiosity and anticipation of another story.

episode.endHook: Agli baar: purane baghon mein pani kaise pohanchta tha?
episode.description: نانا ابو، اریبہ کو اسلامی جیومیٹری کے خوب صورت نقش دکھاتے ہیں۔ دیکھیے، پرکار اور سیدھے پیمانے سے دائرہ کیسے ستارہ بنتا ہے، پھر یہی نقش پوری دیوار سجاتا ہے۔
